title: Running Commentary on Torah 54 — Va'yehi Mi'Ketz Sh'nasayim Yamim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 54 — ויהי מקץ שנתים ימים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening pasuk**: **"Va'yehi mi'ketz sh'nasayim yamim u'Pharaoh choleim, v'hinei omed al ha'ye'or, v'hinei min ha'ye'or olos sheva paros..."** (Bereshis 41:1-2).

intermediate.en: **"Va'yehi mi'ketz sh'nasayim yamim u'Pharaoh choleim"** (Ber 41:1-2).
intermediate.he: **"ויהי מקץ שנתיים ימים ופרעה חולם"** (בר' מא, א-ב).

beginner.en: **Second pasuk**: **"Hashem Elokai gadalta me'od, hod v'hadar lavashta, oteh ohr k'salma, noteh shamayim ki'yri'ah"** (Tehillim 104:1-2).

intermediate.en: **"Hashem Elokai gadalta me'od..."** (Teh 104:1-2).
intermediate.he: **"ה' אלוקי גדלת מאוד..."** (תה' קד, א-ב).

beginner.en: **"α. Must guard **zikaron** very much so he doesn't fall into **shich'chah** (forgetfulness) = **misas ha'lev**. Ikkar ha'zikaron: **remember olam ha'ba constantly** — never think, cha'v, there is only one world. Via cleaving machshavah to **alma d'asi**, **yichud 'Hashem Elokai'** is made. (Hashem+Elokim = shem malei = olam ha'ba; Sabba Mishpatim 98 on this pasuk: **'Hashem Elokai=sh'rusa d'mehemnusa, s'liku d'machshavah d'alma d'asi.'**)"**

intermediate.en: **α. Guard zikaron** from **shich'chah=misas ha'lev**. Ikkar zikaron=**remember olam ha'ba constantly** → **yichud Hashem Elokai** (Sabba Mishp 98 "Hashem Elokai=sh'rusa d'mehemnusa, s'liku machshavah d'alma d'asi").
intermediate.he: **α. שמירת זיכרון** משכחה=**מיתת הלב**. עיקר זיכרון=**לזכור עוה"ב תמיד** → **ייחוד ה' אלוקי** (סבא משפ' צח "שירותא דמהימנותא, סליקו דמחשבה דעלמא דאתי").

beginner.en: **"β. This is in **klal + prat**. **Klal**: on awakening, before anything else, **remember olam ha'ba immediately**. **Prat**: all olam hazeh is **hislavshus of madreigos tachtonos of kedushah** = **raglayin** of kedushah — **'v'ha'aretz hadom raglai'** (Yeshayahu 66:1). Although upper madreigos of kedushah also have revelation in olam hazeh, they are **mainly visible via raglayin/tachtonos**. In every thing in this world, there is a hint to upper madreigos. The sechel must **expand to grasp these hints**."**

intermediate.en: **β. Klal+prat**: klal=awake-remember-olam-ha'ba; prat=every thing hints upper madreigos ("v'ha'aretz hadom raglai," Yesh 66:1; raglayin d'kedushah).
intermediate.he: **β. כלל+פרט**: כלל=קימה-זכירת-עוה"ב; פרט=כל דבר מרמז דרגות עליונות ("והארץ הדום רגלי", יש' סו, א; רגלין דקדושה).

beginner.en: **"Expanding the sechel must be **b'middah** — not leaving the gvul of kedushah; only per his human sechel can he expand. Don't look beyond his madreigah — **'ba'mufla mim'cha al tidrosh'** (Chagigah 13a). **'Gadalta me'od, hod v'hadar lavashta'** = when taking anything from this world (=hod v'hadar=raglayin clothed in it), must be **'gadalta me'od'** = expansion **b'middah + tzimtzum**; **'me'od' = sitra d'smola** = tzimtzum."**

intermediate.en: **Expansion b'middah** (not beyond gvul). "Ba'mufla mim'cha" (Chag 13a). "Gadalta me'od, hod v'hadar" = expansion b'tzimtzum; **"me'od"=sitra d'smola=tzimtzum**.
intermediate.he: **הרחבה במידה** (ללא חריגה). "במופלא ממך" (חג' יג). "גדלת מאוד, הוד והדר" = הרחבה בצמצום; **"מאוד"=סיטרא דשמאלא=צמצום**.

beginner.en: **"(Sabba Mishpatim on this pasuk: **'Hod v'hadar lavashta = ilein trei badei aravos'** etc. — the 2 willow-branches of the lulav = Netzach+Hod = raglayin.)"**

intermediate.en: Sabba: "Hod v'hadar lavashta = trei badei aravos"=N+H=raglayin.
intermediate.he: סבא: "הוד והדר = תרי בדי ערבות"=נ+ה=רגלין.

beginner.en: **"Even one who understands these remazim in everything — if he decides he may engage **only in olam hazeh's affairs** (since he understands the remazim) — that's wrong. One must have **histapkus** (contentment), taking from this world only what is **essential**, for 2 reasons: (1) this clothed-kedushah is **raglayin = low kedushah** (**'avon akeivai y'suveini,'** Tehillim 49:6); and (2) (stated below)."**

intermediate.en: Even one grasping remazim: must have **histapkus**, only essentials. 2 reasons: (1) raglayin=low kedushah (Teh 49:6); (2) below.
intermediate.he: גם התופס רמזים: חייב **הסתפקות**, רק הכרחי. ב' טעמים: (1) רגלין=קדושה נמוכה (תה' מט, ו); (2) להלן.

beginner.en: **"γ. **Masses** (hamon am) who lack this sechel — it happens **automatically** for them through **sheinah, tzitzis, tefillin, Torah, tefilah, and masa u'matan**. **Sheinah** = bechina of attaching machshavah to alma d'asi in klal (= Hashem Elokai) — for during sheinah, **the neshamah ascends to alma d'asi** (Zohar Lech Lecha 83b). **Tzitzis + tefillin** = bechina of **'gadalta me'od'** (tefillin = hagdalas ha'sechel). Torah + tefilah + masa u'matan = bechina of prat."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Masses**: auto via **sheinah** (neshamah→alma d'asi, Zohar Lech Lecha 83b; =Hashem Elokai/klal), **tzitzis+tefillin** (=gadalta me'od), Torah/tefilah/MaU"M (=prat).
intermediate.he: **γ. המון עם**: אוטומטית דרך **שינה** (נשמה→עלמא דאתי, זוה"ק לך לך פג:), **ציצית+תפילין** (=גדלת מאוד), תורה/תפילה/מו"מ (=פרט).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. זוה"ק לך לך פג:.

beginner.en: **"δ. To guard this zikaron, must guard against **ra ayin=misas ha'lev**. Ikkar zikaron in the **ayin** — **'u'l'zikaron bein einecha'** (Shemos 13:9). Shich'chah via ra ayin/misas ha'lev: **'nishkachti k'meis mi'lev'** (Tehillim 31:13). Ra ayin + misas ha'lev = one bechina — **'shurina d'eina b'liba talya'** (Avodah Zarah 28b). Naval was ra ayin — **'va'yamas libo b'kirbo'** (Shmuel I 25:37)."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Guard zikaron from ra ayin=misas ha'lev**. Zikaron in ayin (Shem 13:9 "bein einecha"); shich'chah="nishkachti k'meis mi'lev" (Teh 31:13). "Shurina d'eina b'liba talya" (AZ 28b). Naval (Sh"A 25:37).
intermediate.he: **δ. שמירת זיכרון מרע עין=מיתת הלב**. זיכרון בעין (שמ' יג, ט "בין עיניך"); שכחה="נשכחתי כמת מלב" (תה' לא, יג). "שורינא דעינא בליבא תליא" (ע"ז כח:). נבל (ש"א כה, לז).

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. שמ' יג, ט; תה' לא, יג; ע"ז כח:; ש"א כה, לז.

beginner.en: **Niddah 24b**: **"Tanya: Abba Shaul omer: kover meisim hayisi. Pa'am achas niftechah mi'arah mi'tachtai, v'amadti b'galgal eino shel meis, ad chotmi. Ke'she'chazarti l'achorai, amru: ein shel Avshalom hava."** 'I was a burier of the dead. Once a cave opened under me, and I stood up to my nostrils in the eye-socket of a corpse. When I returned, they said: it was Avshalom's eye.'

intermediate.en: **Nid 24b Abba Shaul**: cave opened, stood in meis's eye-socket up to nose — said it was **Avshalom's**.
intermediate.he: **נדה כד: אבא שאול**: מערה נפתחה, עמד בעין המת עד חוטם — אבשלום.

beginner.en: **"Peirush**: **Abba Shaul toiled to rectify ra ayin = misas** always. **'Pa'am achas niftechah mi'arah mi'tachtai'** — **'arah = deveikus** (**'k'ma'ar ish v'liyos,'** Melachim I 7:36); **mi'tachtai = emes** (**'emes mei'eretz titzmach,'** Tehillim 85:12). **'Tov ayin hu y'vorach'** (Mishlei 22:9); brachos = emes (**'ha'misbareich ba'aretz yisbareich b'Elokei amen,'** Yeshayahu 65:16). Via his emes, deveikus opened for him. He **'amad b'galgal ein shel Avshalom ad chotmi'** — Avshalom's eye = **ra ayin** epitomized (he who rebelled with ra ayin). Stood there **'ad chotmi'** — the **chotem** is the **filter**; he brought his nose-discernment to the very source of ra ayin and **fixed/distinguished** it."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: Abba Shaul rectifies ra ayin=misas. "Arah"=deveikus (Mel I 7:36); "mi'tachtai"=emes (Teh 85:12; Yesh 65:16). Tov ayin→brachos=emes. Avshalom's eye=ra ayin; "ad chotmi"=filter/discernment.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: אבא שאול מתקן רע עין=מת. "ערה"=דבקות (מל"א ז, לו); "מתחתי"=אמת (תה' פה, יב; יש' סה, טז). טוב עין→ברכות=אמת. עין אבשלום=רע עין; "עד חוטמי"=מסנן/אבחנה.

scholarly.he: נדה כד:; מל"א ז, לו; תה' פה, יב; מש' כב, ט; יש' סה, טז.

beginner.en: **"ε. Guard the ayin from **koach ha'medameh**. Even tov ayin must guard. Even keen-sighted people can err — seeing from afar and imagining the opposite of truth. **Koach ha'medameh comes via lashon hara** — for koach ha'medameh is bechina of **behemiyus** (animals also have ha'medameh). **'Motzi dibah hu k'sil'** (Mishlei 10:18) — 'the slanderer is a fool' — **k'sil = behemiyus**. When one slanders, he falls to behemiyus → koach ha'medameh overpowers."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Guard ayin from koach ha'medameh** (even tov ayin). Medameh=behemiyus. Lashon hara → fall to behemiyus → medameh overpowers (Mishlei 10:18 "motzi dibah k'sil").
intermediate.he: **ε. שמירת עין ממדמה** (גם לטוב עין). מדמה=בהמיות. לשה"ר → נפילה לבהמיות → מדמה גובר (מש' י, יח "מוציא דיבה כסיל").

beginner.en: **"ζ. The koach ha'medameh **constantly seeks a keli to dwell in** — hence it hovers around **'shoneh halachos'** (one who recites halachos by rote without understanding). If they innovate something in Torah, the chiddush is pretty and well-received — but it's **from koach ha'medameh** (which compares thing to thing); the ra outweighs tov. These chiddushim **damage parnasah** — for Torah-chiddushim create **heavens and earth** (Yeshayahu 51:16; Hakd Zohar: **'amee=imee'** — in My partnership), but chiddushim from medameh create **unsteady worlds → parnasah unsteady**."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Medameh seeks keli → hovers on "shoneh halachos"** (rote-reciters). Their chiddushim pretty (from medameh's mlasa-l'mlasa), but ra > tov; damage parnasah (Torah-chiddushim create shamayim+aretz; Yesh 51:16; Hakd Zohar "amee=imee").
intermediate.he: **ז. מדמה מחפש כלי → שוכן על "שונה הלכות"** (שונים בעל פה). חידושיהם נאים (מלתא למלתא), אבל הרע > הטוב; מזיק לפרנסה (חידושי תורה בוראים שמים+ארץ; יש' נא, טז; הקד' זוה"ק "עמי=עימי").

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. יש' נא, טז; הקד' זוה"ק.

beginner.en: **"**'V'al ha'shanos ha'chalom'** (Bereshis 41:32) = chalom (= koach ha'medameh) **striving to rest on shoneh halachos**. **'Nachon ha'davar mei'im ha'Elokim, u'mmaher ha'Elokim la'asoso'** — bechina of **'asher bara Elokim la'asos'** — prepared erev Shabbos bein ha'shmashos, kidesh ha'yom, Elokim rushed to make b'lo guf; hence medameh constantly circles seeking shoneh halachos. **'Chalom Pharaoh echad hu'** — Pharaoh's chalom = koach ha'medameh = **bateil** (**'kol chayil Pharaoh,'** lashon batel)."**

intermediate.en: **"V'al ha'shanos ha'chalom"** (Ber 41:32): chalom/medameh seeks shoneh halachos. **"Asher bara Elokim la'asos"** — b'lo guf. "Chalom Pharaoh echad hu" — medameh=bateil.
intermediate.he: **"ועל השנות החלום"** (בר' מא, לב): חלום/מדמה מחפש שונה הלכות. **"אשר ברא אלוקים לעשות"** — ללא גוף. "חלום פרעה אחד הוא" — מדמה=בטל.

beginner.en: **"Thus: via **histalkus ha'da'as** (from lashon hara — **'motzi dibah hu k'sil'** = da'as departed), one falls from **ahavas Hashem to ahavos behemiyus**. Then medameh=behemiyus overpowers. Via medameh, **zikaron is damaged → falls into shich'chah**. **'Nadmu ami mi'b'li ha'da'as'** (Hoshea 4:6) — via pgam da'as, medameh overpowers; **'ki atah ha'da'as ma'asta...'** — continuation."**

intermediate.en: Pgam da'as (from lashon hara) → fall to ahavos behemiyus → medameh/behemiyus overpowers → zikaron damaged → shich'chah. **"Nadmu ami mi'b'li ha'da'as"** (Hoshea 4:6).
intermediate.he: פגם דעת (מלה"ר) → נפילה לאהבות בהמיות → מדמה/בהמיות גובר → פגם זיכרון → שכחה. **"נדמו עמי מבלי הדעת"** (הו' ד, ו).

beginner.en: **"η. To subdue medameh — via bechina of **yad**: **'u'v'yad ha'neviim adameh'** (Hoshea 12:11). **Yad=simchah** — **'u'semachtem b'chol mishlach yed'chem'** (Devarim 12:7). Bechina of **klei zemer played with the hand** — through which **nevuah rests on neviim** — **'k'chu li m'nagen'** (Melachim II 3:15). The **keli is the gathering of ruach**; it mixes tov v'ra: there is **atzvus ru'ach, ru'ach n'cha'ah** (Mishlei 15:4; Yeshayahu 54:6; 43:14), **ru'ach ra'ah** (Shmuel I 16:14 — 'u'bi'asatu ru'ach ra'ah mei'eis Hashem')."**

intermediate.en: **η. Subdue medameh via yad=simchah** (Dev 12:7). Klei zemer played by hand → nevuah (Mel II 3:15 "k'chu m'nagen"; Hosh 12:11 "u'v'yad adameh"). Keli=gathers ruach; mixes tov+ra (Sh"A I 16:14).
intermediate.he: **ז. הכנעת מדמה ע"י יד=שמחה** (דב' יב, ז). כלי זמר ביד → נבואה (מל"ב ג, טו; הו' יב, יא "ביד אדמה"). כלי=מאסף רוח; מערב טוב+רע (ש"א טז, יד).

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. דב' יב, ז; הו' יב, יא; מל"ב ג, טו; ש"א טז, יד.

beginner.en: **"Via **playing on the keli with hand**, the **tov-ruach is sifted from the ra-ruach** = ru'ach nevuah. All this = subduing medameh (= ru'ach ra'ah/shtus) that wants to **confuse the ru'ach tovah/nevuah**. It's subdued by **simchah from the menagen**. Ikar medameh's strengthening is via **atzvus** (ru'ach nechei'ah) — hence simchah breaks it."**

intermediate.en: Menagen-yad sifts tov-ruach from ra-ruach=nevuah. Medameh=ru'ach ra'ah/shtus confuses nevuah. Simchah breaks it (medameh=atzvus).
intermediate.he: מנגן ביד מברר רוח טובה מרוח רעה=נבואה. מדמה=רוח רעה/שטות מבלבל נבואה. שמחה שוברת (מדמה=עצבות).

beginner.en: **"**Peirush pasuk**: **'Va'yehi mi'ketz sh'nasayim yamim'** — 'sh'nasayim yamim'=motz'iei dibah ('yom la'shanah yom la'shanah,' Bamidbar 14:34). Through them **ahavah d'kedushah** (=**'v'kamatz ha'kohen'**) was blemished = **pgam ha'kometz**. **Mi'ketz** = pgam ha'kometz. **'U'Pharaoh choleim'** = koach ha'medameh. **'V'hinei omed al ha'ye'or'** — **ye'or=Pishon** — **'pi shoneh halachos'** (medameh rests on them). **'U'min ha'ye'or'** — **sheva shnei sava u'sheva shnei ra'av** = tov v'ra."**

intermediate.en: **"Mi'ketz sh'nasayim"** (Ber 41:1): pgam kometz (Bam 14:34). **"Pharaoh choleim"**=medameh. **Ye'or=Pishon=pi shoneh halachos** (medameh rests). **"Sheva shnei sava/ra'av"**=tov+ra.
intermediate.he: **"מקץ שנתיים"** (בר' מא, א): פגם קמץ (במ' יד, לד). **"פרעה חולם"**=מדמה. **יאר=פישון=פי שונה הלכות** (מדמה שוכן). **"שבע שני שבע/רעב"**=טוב+רע.

scholarly.he: בר' מא, א; במ' יד, לד.

beginner.en: **"**'Ezk'rah n'ginasi ba'laylah, im l'vavi asichah, va'y'chapes ruchi'** (Tehillim 77:7). **Ba'laylah** — then is the **pikdonos ha'ruchos** — **'b'yadcha afkid ruchi.'** Time to **gather tov-ruach from ra-ruach**. **Ikar hisbodedus time**: alone with his lev, searching tov-ruach amid ra-ruach — this is **nigun**. Via it, zikaron is guarded."**

intermediate.en: **"Ezk'rah n'ginasi ba'laylah"** (Teh 77:7): ba'laylah=pikdonos ruchos; gather tov from ra = **nigun**; ikar hisbodedus-time; guards zikaron.
intermediate.he: **"אזכרה נגינתי בלילה"** (תה' עז, ז): לילה=פיקדונות הרוחות; בירור טוב מרע = **ניגון**; עיקר התבודדות; שומר זיכרון.

beginner.en: **"ι. Bechina of **kimah b'chatzos ha'laylah**: David's **kinor** was hung above his bed, and when chatzos came it played by itself (Berachos 3b). Then the nigun d'kedushah of kinor David awakens = **sifting tov-ruach**. Therefore chatzos is the time to arise for **avodas Hashem + hisbodedus**."**

intermediate.en: **ι. Kimah b'chatzos**: David's kinor above bed plays at chatzos (Ber 3b). Time for **avodah + hisbodedus** = sifting ruach.
intermediate.he: **ι. קימה בחצות**: כינור דוד מעל מיטתו מנגן בחצות (בר' ג:). עת ל**עבודה + התבודדות** = בירור רוח.

beginner.en: **R"N bracket**: **"Torah said on Shabbos Chanukah. After saying it, he said: 'I now told how to light Ner Chanukah — bechina of **'l'amshacha meshach revus kadshah u'l'adlaka botzina'** (drawing the anointing oil to light the lamp; Zohar Bereshis 31 + various) — **'shemen mishchas kodesh'** (Shemos 30:25) = **da'as**. I.e., **hagdalas ha'da'as = zikaron** as above.' He didn't explain more."**

intermediate.en: R"N: said on Shabbos Chanukah; Ner Chanukah="l'amshacha meshach revus kadshah u'l'adlaka botzina" (Zohar Ber 31)=shemen mishchas kodesh (Shem 30:25)=da'as=zikaron.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: נאמרה בשבת חנוכה; נר חנוכה="לאמשכא משח רבות קדשא ולאדלקא בוצינא" (זוה"ק בר' לא)=שמן משחת קדש (שמ' ל, כה)=דעת=זיכרון.

scholarly.he: זוה"ק בר' לא; שמ' ל, כה.

beginner.en: **"Relates above: **'Mi asaf ruach b'chafnav, mi tzarar mayim ba'simlah'** (Mishlei 30:4). **'Yasheiv rucho yizlu mayim'** (Tehillim 147:18): via gathering ruach in his yad, **'yizlu mayim'** = bechina of **'tzarar mayim = ha'lev'** = **'shifchi ka'mayim libech.'**"**

intermediate.en: **"Mi asaf ruach...mi tzarar mayim"** (Mishlei 30:4). "Yasheiv rucho yizlu mayim" (Teh 147:18): gather ruach in yad → yizlu mayim = lev ("shifchi ka'mayim libech").
intermediate.he: **"מי אסף רוח... מי צרר מים"** (מש' ל, ד). "ישב רוחו יזלו מים" (תה' קמז, יח): אסף רוח ביד → יזלו מים = לב ("שפכי כמים לבך").

scholarly.he: מש' ל, ד; תה' קמז, יח.

beginner.en: **"Klal**: Chazal (Pesachim 66a; Niddah 19b): **'ein adam dan gzeirah shavah mei'atzmo'**. Why? Because it could be from **koach ha'medameh** (compares thing to thing). Hence **asur** to dan gzeirah shavah from oneself — only if received **from his rav, from rav's rav, all the way to Moshe mi'pi ha'gevurah** — to be **saved from koach ha'medameh**. U'Vin."**

intermediate.en: **Klal**: Pes 66a / Nid 19b: "ein adam dan gzeirah shavah mei'atzmo" — because could be **medameh**. Only via chain from Moshe (saves from medameh).
intermediate.he: **כלל**: פס' סו / נד' יט:: "אין אדם דן גזירה שווה מעצמו" — אולי **מדמה**. רק דרך מסורת ממשה (ניצול ממדמה).
